name: agentcore-chat
description: Chat with your Amazon Bedrock AgentCore agents (HTTP and A2A) from VS Code

agentcore.pythonPath.description: Path to Python interpreter with boto3 installed

agentcore.mock.markdownDescription: Use a built-in **mock** AgentCore instead of AWS. For local development and demos; replies are fake.

agentcore.region.markdownDescription: AWS region for AgentCore. Defaults to `eu-central-1`; clear it to use the region from your AWS profile instead.

enumDescriptions: Stream when the agent's Agent Card says it supports streaming, otherwise send
agentcore.a2aStreaming.markdownDescription: How to call **A2A** agents: `message/stream` (live status and streamed text) or `message/send` (one answer). `auto` follows the agent's Agent Card (needs `bedrock-agentcore:GetAgentCard`; without it, `auto` sends).

enumDescriptions: The main text, then every other field as readable Markdown (lists, tables)
Only the main text (message, result, response...)
The whole reply as a JSON block
agentcore.jsonReplies.markdownDescription: How to show agent replies that are **JSON**. Also used for A2A data parts and the extra fields of a stream's final event.

agentcore.jsonHiddenFields.markdownDescription: Field names to leave out when showing JSON replies as Markdown (any level, case-insensitive), in addition to the built-in ones (`role`, `usage`, `metrics`, token counts, trace/request/session ids, stop reason, latency).

agentcore.debugRawResponses.markdownDescription: Log every raw response line to the **AgentCore Chat** Output channel. Useful for capturing real responses as test fixtures; may log sensitive content.
